cable.units: atlas px at 2x density (fx.json scale 2): halve for layout units
cable.tile: cable-carrier 32x12, anchor (0,6) = cable centre row; repeats every 32 px horizontally
cable.sag: draw column by column in HD (backing) px: for each HD column X along the span blit column (X mod 32) of cable-carrier at HD y = 2*sag(X/2) - 6 (sag in layout units)
cable.steps: cable-carrier-down/up: 32x14 tiles with a 2-px step at x=16, anchors (0,6)/(0,8), for coarse tile-by-tile curves
cable.thin: cable-carrier-thin 32x6, anchor (0,3), no dark edge, for background routes; same column method with y = 2*sag(X/2) - 3
cable.handshake: handshake-hello|hear|hearhear: 64x14 pulses (1/2/3 beads) riding the cable, anchor (0,7) = cable centre at the segment start; loop along the segment while that stage fills; handshake-complete (67x67, anchor 33,33) when HOP is ready
